title: expression gate: flow-condition type-mismatch verdicts still miss or misdescribe three sites after #29926 (non-record-triggered flows, record.x, decision branches) and MCP validate_expression cannot carry severity or trigger kind
body:
domain:server#6 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzibcN9oHa8kDbTTnL5

Filing gate: ① a product defect with named landing points. These are the open readings of the #29926 dev and the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review of PR #29953 (comment 6610931370 ③, re-review 6611149064), measured at head `06abf5ac`.
Business reason: an author is told something untrue about runtime, or nothing at all, for a condition that fails every flow run.
Reader who acts: `domain:server`. Landing points are `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts` (`faultOutcomeOf`, the flow node, edge and decision sites, and `checkDeclaredPredicate`) and `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` (the `validate_expression` site map).
Dedupe (open and closed): `decision branch type-mismatch` and `"evaluates to null" flow condition`. Nearest are #29926 (open, landing in PR #29953: record-triggered start and edge only) and #29904 (closed). Neither covers these sites.

## Sites

1. **Non-record-triggered flows** (no `triggerType`, `schedule`, API-started): a type mismatch in a start or edge condition keeps the warning "silently evaluates to null". That text is false here too: `dag-traversal.ts` `evaluateCondition` throws on a non-`ok` evaluation for every flow. Decide the grading (the null-guard twin has no grading here) and at least make the text true. PR #29953 pins the current warning as the intended behaviour, so update that pin.
2. **`record.x` in a flow condition** is never type-judged. The flattened-scope soundness check types bare names only.
3. **`decision` branches get no type verdict**: `checkDeclaredPredicate` calls `validateExpression('predicate', raw)` with no schema hint, so no `fieldTypes` and no `faultOutcome` reach it, and `name > 5` on a text field fails the run with no verdict. The null-guard twin alone refuses there.
4. **MCP `validate_expression`**: the site map has no input for a validation rule's `severity` or a flow's trigger kind, so `validation` always answers fail-closed (the gate serves fail-open for an advisory rule) and `flow_condition` always answers `run-fails` (the gate warns for a non-record-triggered flow). The tool text says it "answers what the gate will". Either add the inputs or say where it differs.

Measured on PR #29953's head `06abf5ac`. Re-measure once it lands.
